_about: The video script. Edit text here, never in build/. Text fields may use {key} for a number from game.json, {key:word} for it spelled out, {key:Word} capitalised, {key:rations} for 'two rations' / 'one ration'. Derived keys: seats, game_span, scavenge_spoken, guard_span, join_spoken, name1..name4. Run build.py to see every available key. base_duration_s is the planned length; build.py stretches it if the narration gets longer, and uses the real voiceover length once a scene is recorded. Beat times are written against base_duration_s and scaled automatically.

scenes.title: Hook
scenes.narration: For the next {game_span}, the office becomes a survival game. Food is scarce, everyone is hungry, and anyone could turn on you.

beats.do: Office floor plan fades in at night (office_floorplan_night).
Two or three desk lamps flicker gently (under 3 flashes per second).
Desks morph into tents one cluster at a time (tent, top_down).
title_logo slams in centre with a small dust puff; hold to the end.

scenes.title: The goal
scenes.narration: The game runs for {rounds:word} workdays. Your goal: stay alive, and on the last night, grab one of {seats:word} seats on the rescue helicopter.

beats.do: calendar_strip slides in from the left.
Tiles tick off one by one, evenly, until all {rounds} are ticked by 6.0 s.
Camera pans right to the helicopter with {seats} empty seats, rotor idling.
On-screen text appears.

scenes.title: Food
scenes.narration: Everyone starts with {start_rations:word} rations. Every night, you eat {eat:word}. Run out, and you become a bandit. More on that later.

beats.do: One avatar (standing) with {start_rations} ration_tin in a row beside them.
moon_sun cycles above; each night {eat} tin pops away, speeding up, until none are left at 7.0 s.
bandit_mask drops onto the avatar's face with a thunk; hold.

scenes.title: Your daily move
scenes.narration: Each day, you pick one secret move in Discord before {deadline}. Nobody else can see what you chose. You have five options.

beats.do: ui_phone_chat slides up from the bottom.
Thumb taps the message box; '/steal' types in.
Phone shrinks to the left; the five action_icons fan out in an arc with their labels.
On-screen text appears.

scenes.title: Scavenge
scenes.narration: Scavenge. Go looking for food and find {scavenge_spoken}. If you forget to play, you scavenge automatically.

beats.do: icon_scavenge badge pins to the top-left corner and stays for the scene.
Avatar (digging pose) rummages in the bin.
slot_counter spins and lands on each value from {scavenge_min} to {scavenge_max} in turn, a tin popping out for each.
Small clock icon with 'missed it? auto-scavenge'.

scenes.title: Steal
scenes.narration: Steal. Pick someone and take {steal_amount:word} of their rations. They'll know they were robbed. They won't know it was you.

beats.do: icon_steal badge pins top-left. Avatar sleeping beside 4 tins.
thief_shadow tiptoes in from the right.
Thief lifts {steal_amount} tins and slips away.
Avatar wakes (startled pose) with question_mark bouncing above.

scenes.title: Guard
scenes.narration: Guard. You're protected {guard_span}. Anyone who tries to rob you gets caught, named in the news, and pays you {guard_reward:rations}. You only get {guard_limit:word} guards, so choose your moment.
scenes.on_screen_text: GUARD: {guard_nights} nights · thief pays you {guard_reward} · {guard_limit} per game

beats.do: icon_guard badge pins top-left. Avatar with shield_glow over them.
{guard_nights} nights pass above (moon, sun, moon) to show the shield lasting.
thief_shadow sneaks in and bounces off the shield.
spotlight snaps on the thief; small banner 'CAUGHT'.
Thief hands {guard_reward} tins to the guard.
shield_counter appears: {guard_limit} shields, one greys out.

scenes.title: Investigate
scenes.narration: Investigate. Spy on one person and find out what they did that night. Catch them stealing, and they're exposed and pay you {investigate_bounty:rations}.

beats.do: icon_investigate badge pins top-left. Row of tents (front_with_window), night.
magnifying_glass_large sweeps across the tents and stops at one window.
Through the lens: thief_shadow taking a tin.
stamp_exposed slams over the window.
{investigate_bounty} tin flies from the thief to the investigator avatar.

scenes.title: Gift
scenes.narration: Gift. Give some of your food to someone else. Only the two of you will know.

beats.do: icon_gift badge pins top-left. Two avatars side by side, soft purple glow.
One avatar passes a tin to the other.
Both do the finger-to-lips pose.

scenes.title: The morning news
scenes.narration: Every morning at {news_time_spoken}, the news drops in Discord: who got robbed, who got caught, and who ran out of food. You'll always know what happened. You'll rarely know who did it.

beats.do: ui_news_post slides in; header '{news_time} MORNING NEWS'.
Line 1 appears (robbery).
Line 2 appears (caught thief).
Line 3 appears (ran out of food).
A big '?' fades in over the screen on 'You'll rarely know who did it'.

scenes.title: Bandits
scenes.narration: Run out of food and you're a bandit. Bandits can only steal, but get back to {bandit_rejoin:rations} and you rejoin the survivors.

beats.do: Avatar wearing bandit_mask sneaks between tents.
Steals {bandit_steal_amount} tin at a time; a counter above them climbs from 0 to {bandit_rejoin}.
bandit_mask flies off; the avatar's colours brighten back to normal.

scenes.title: Secret goal and radio
scenes.narration: You'll also get a secret goal that only you know about. And once a day you can post an anonymous message on the radio channel. Tips, accusations, lies. Your call.
scenes.on_screen_text: Secret goal · 1 anonymous radio message a day

beats.do: secret_envelope drops in and wobbles; wax seal glints. Never open it.
Cut to ui_radio_channel with radio_icon; three anonymous messages pop in at 5.5, 7.0 and 8.5 s.
On-screen text appears.

scenes.title: Extraction and the reveal
scenes.narration: On the last night, the helicopter lands. The {seats:word} survivors with the most food get a seat. A seat and your secret goal both earn points, and the most points wins. Then comes the big reveal: every theft and every secret, out in the open.

beats.do: Night sky; helicopter descends, rotor spinning, dust blowing.
{seats} avatars (mixed colours) climb aboard one by one; seats light up.
scoreboard flips in.
MUSIC CUT. Drumroll.
curtain pulls open on news_clipping_wall with 'THE REVEAL' in the headline font.

scenes.title: How to join
scenes.narration: It takes {minutes_per_day:word} minutes a day, it's completely optional, and nothing in the game touches real work or real money. Type {join_spoken} in Discord and you'll get a secret alias, so nobody knows who's who. And remember: trust no one.

beats.do: ui_join: '{join_command}' typed, the bot's private reply reveals the alias '{name1}'.
Background: tents morph back into desks; lights come up to day_bg.
End card: title_logo (small) + 'trust no one'. Hold to the end.
